tasks.title: Derive the matched classical baseline for supersingular path-finding under one cost convention

handoff.objective: Under one named cost convention, derive separately for the F_{p^2} and F_p regimes what the honest matched classical baseline for supersingular isogeny path-finding is, and either define the low-memory isogeny-graph collision-search analogue precisely or falsify it.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether Wiener-style full-cost accounting changes the identity of the matched classical baseline in either regime, or whether Delfs-Galbraith dominance on F_p and MITM's memory charge on F_{p^2} leave the published ranking unchanged, so that IDEA-20260725-001 is documentation only.
inputs: IDEA-20260725-001 as revised by DEC-20260725-002 (disposition revise, ADMIT_BASELINE_DERIVATION_FOR_BATCH_002)
RT-20260725-503 fatal objections F1, F2 and nonfatal objections N1, N2, N4 and its required_scope_fixes
TASK-20260725-501 baseline_map.md and candidate_report.yaml at snapshot 1d907a5
The repository knowledge spine cited by TASK-20260725-501 (KN-TECH-024..029, KN-TECH-035, KN-TECH-044, KN-LIT-094, KN-OPEN-013..015)
constraints: ZERO CURVE COMPUTE. Perform no isogeny evaluation, no j-invariant computation, no graph sampling, no timing run, and no experiment. This is a derivation task only.

Treat F_{p^2} generic path-finding and F_p-rational (Delfs-Galbraith-eligible) instances as two separate regimes with separate verdicts; a single blended ranking does not discharge RT-20260725-503 objection F2.
Name exactly one cost convention and apply it identically to every algorithm compared. Asymmetric charging (memory charged to one algorithm only) invalidates the comparison.

Every exponent, constant, or bound asserted must either cite an archived source by ID or be derived in the note itself. Do not import a numeric expectation from an unarchived probe, recollection, or estimate. Where a quantity is not established by an archived source, label it an untested expectation and say so in place.
State every heuristic as a numbered assumption with an explicit falsification condition, per docs/target-result-profile.md. A conditional statement may not be written as unconditional.

Maximum claim strength is a matched-baseline recommendation plus, at most, a proposed KN-TECH baseline note. Claim no break, no sub-p^{1/4} endomorphism-ring attack, and no completion of any GOAL-SSI-001 criterion.

Charge memory, wiring, preprocessing, and verification. Charge no quantum queries and no torsion-image oracle: those lanes are out of scope here (KN-OPEN-014; SIDH regime forbidden as a positive target).
SIDH/SIKE torsion-image key recovery remains a closed known attack and is not a novelty target.
Change no official state, edit no ledger record, and create no evidence, decision, or hypothesis record.
Record the requested policy, the resolved model identifier, whether fallback was used, and whether the session was independent. Do not silently substitute a model.
completion_gate: G1 F_{p^2} REGIME: the note states MITM's time exponent and its space exponent separately for generic supersingular path-finding, then applies the named full-cost convention to the table, and reports whether MITM's full-cost exponent strictly exceeds its step-count exponent or provably collapses to it. The wiring/access model is stated as a numbered assumption.

G2 F_p REGIME: the note states Delfs-Galbraith's step count and its memory under the same convention and decides explicitly whether MITM is ever competitive on F_p-rational instances, addressing RT-20260725-503 objection F2 by name.

G3 LOW-MEMORY ANALOGUE, DEFINED OR FALSIFIED: either the note gives an explicit walk law on the isogeny graph, a distinguished-point predicate, the collision-to-path reconstruction step, the any-collision versus golden-collision distinction, and the expected cost with each heuristic numbered; or it falsifies the analogue by identifying exactly what the construction requires that is not available without an uncharged oracle or nonstandard graph access. A verdict of 'underspecified' with no resolution does not close this gate.

G4 RECOMMENDATION: baseline_recommendation.yaml emits one matched-baseline verdict per regime, names the cost convention, lists what remains uncharged, and states which of the three pre-registered falsification outcomes of IDEA-20260725-001 (MITM full cost collapses; low-memory analogue undefinable; Delfs-Galbraith dominant with no decision-relevant correction) fired, or that none fired.

G5 COMPLETION-CONDITION FLAG: baseline_recommendation.yaml sets new_attack_mechanism_detected true or false with justification. If true, the mechanism is described as a candidate for a separate Coordinator decision and is NOT claimed; if false, the note states plainly that BATCH-002 does not count toward GOAL-SSI-001 completion criteria.

G6 LIMITS: the note separates established literature, derivation, and speculation, and lists what the derivation cannot establish, including that asymptotic full-cost statements settle baseline identity and not concrete bit-security.

handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the derivation's verdict survives adversarial reading, or whether asymmetric charging, an unsourced exponent, an uncharged oracle, or an overclaimed ranking change explains it.

RT-20260725-503 required_scope_fixes, which this derivation was dispatched to discharge

Distinguish absence of evidence from impossibility.
